title: BlyxoHub | KEYLESS
features:
BlyxoHub - Ride A Pet (Free) | V1.1

Auto-steal eggs, filter targets, and bring them back to your plot with a clean mobile-friendly UI.

FEATURES





Auto Steal — finds the best available egg, travels to it, picks it up, and returns it to your plot



Target Egg — choose a specific egg from the list, sorted by luck, with live egg previews



Refresh Eggs — refreshes the current egg board



Go to My Plot — quickly teleport back to your plot



Farm tab — protected by the Vampauth key system



Auto Farm — continuously farms using your selected luck, rarity, and mutation filters



Min Luck filter — skip eggs below a selected luck value



Rarity filter — choose which rarities to target



Mutation filter — target specific mutations



Auto Hatch — automatically hatches grown eggs on your plot



Dynamic Island — shows the current action and live progress percentage



Live stats — FPS, ping, and session time



FPS Boost — reduces heavy effects and graphics load for smoother gameplay



Join Smallest Server



Rejoin Server



Webhook support for activity notifications



Profiles — save settings and enable Auto Load



Mobile-friendly controls, animations, and layouts



Automatically stops safely if the game detects a problem
